slides.caption: Save and reopen both modes
slides.action: Save mapping and reload at the same origin.
slides.expected: Version 2 graph, both custom curves and full score persist; selection/input reset to step 1/50.

slides.caption: Perform the authored graph by pointer
slides.action: Select step 3; set the real Input slider (observed 68); Next/Apply/Next/Apply.
slides.expected: Step 3 Length becomes 60; step 4 Accent becomes 84; unrelated score fields retained.
slides.observed: PASS: full score matched the independent oracle, recorded in results.json.

slides.caption: Perform the same graph on the keyboard pad
slides.action: Restore the test fixture, focus pad; Right/Space/Right/Space, then check wrap.
slides.expected: Same full score as pointer actions, focus retained, correct same-step/advance/wrap behavior.
slides.observed: PASS: full stored score byte-equivalence, focus and wrap assertions matched.

slides.caption: Real calculation failure retains last good panel
slides.action: Set Length midpoint 41, Ctrl+Enter; then enter not-a-number and Ctrl+Enter.
slides.expected: First build installs 41. Real POST /build returns 400 for invalid calculation; installed/saved graph, full score and focused input stay intact, including after reload.
slides.observed: PASS: HTTP 400 awaited; exact records, active Length 41%, retained input/pad nodes and reopen assertions matched.

slides.caption: Reject unsupported graph documents
slides.action: Load ten malformed/unsupported configurations through Versioned configuration.
slides.expected: Every import rejects without changing installed/saved graph, score or current Length mode.
slides.observed: PASS: all ten configuration and retained-state assertions matched.

slides.caption: Preserve corrupt stored graph data
slides.action: Inject malformed JSON, unsupported version and dangling edges in isolated storage, then reload.
slides.expected: Defaults become active with an explicit warning; invalid raw mapping and valid score remain available.
slides.observed: PASS: three malformed-record cases preserved raw storage and score; explicit restore repaired only mapping.

slides.caption: Failed startup rebuild preserves the saved graph
slides.action: Restore the valid saved custom graph; inject a synthetic HTTP 500 for /build and reload.
slides.expected: Defaults temporarily active with Saved response could not be built; the exact stored two-mode graph and full score remain untouched.
slides.observed: PASS: awaited warning and byte-equivalent saved graph/score; screenshot visibly shows fallback and warning. This is a transport fault injection, not the real HTTP 400 build failure.

slides.caption: Recover through the normal saved-graph editor
slides.action: Remove the HTTP 500 fixture; open Versioned configuration, Copy saved to editor, Load draft, Save mapping; reload.
slides.expected: Export must retrieve the stored custom graph rather than active defaults. Both authored modes, 75/41 calculations, transitions and exact score reopen.
slides.observed: PASS: exported graph equality, saved mapping/score byte-equivalence and visible Length mode matched after final reload.

slides.caption: Inspect the reopened graph on a narrow viewport
slides.action: Resize to 390×844 and open Phrase controls.
slides.expected: No horizontal overflow, eight named notes and exactly one selected note.
slides.observed: PASS: width, accessible names/selection and no-page-error assertions matched.
